title: fix(whatsapp): restore media uploads through proxies
body:
Related: #122622. Related investigation: #156601 by @YangManBOBO.

## What Problem This Solves

WhatsApp media uploads fail before any proxy request because Baileys receives an Undici dispatcher where its Node uploader requires an HTTP(S) agent.

## User Impact

Media uses the configured HTTP/HTTPS proxy and evaluates `NO_PROXY` for each actual upload or redirect host, independently of the WebSocket connection. Direct uploads, lowercase variable precedence, and managed proxy CA trust remain supported. Invalid selected proxy routes reject media without silently sending it directly or blocking login/text session creation; intentional bypasses still work.

## Why This Change Was Made

The canonical Node adapter supports library-selected destinations and retains each protocol route's initialization error. One Proxyline Node agent owns dual-protocol/default-port handling and direct-agent cleanup; OpenClaw retains its existing proxy selection, bypass, and proxy-only CA policy. Fixed-destination callers keep their contract. WhatsApp supplies that typed agent to Baileys and destroys connection agents on close; obsolete dispatcher probing and mock-only transport tests are removed.

The approved temporary `@openclaw/proxyline@0.3.12` patch exports its **existing** `ProxylineNodeProxyAgent` class. There is no version bump or proxy implementation change. pnpm generated and registered the patch; only the source entrypoint and regenerated JS/declaration/map change. The root bundles the patched dependency for npm installs. The patch README records its removal gate.

## Evidence

- On pinned base `445eb593e38a37a3c788906a9226c353b3d55c89`, the actual Baileys 7.0.0-rc14 proxy upload failed with `ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE` before proxy I/O; the non-proxy sibling passed.
- **10 real upload cases pass.** Session-supplied options reach the installed Baileys uploader, real local HTTP(S) origins, and CONNECT/forward proxies. Assertions verify complete file bytes and receipts, redirects, per-host bypass, independent origin/proxy CA trust, and invalid-route rejection. Socket creation is mocked; the upload transport is real.
- Pre-fix invalid-route regressions exposed silent direct media delivery, then session-startup failure. Both are covered. The latest regression failed on `0651a43b17` with all proxy routes invalid plus `NO_PROXY`; it now proves bypassed HTTPS upload and HTTP redirect succeed, while a host outside the bypass rejects with no additional origin request and no proxy request.
- The earlier redirect P2 was withdrawn: both actual redirect cases already passed on `226c158bad` using pinned Proxyline's dual-protocol getters. Coverage is retained without claiming a false pre-fix failure.
- **6 canonical adapter tests pass**, including invalid selected routes at both native HTTP and HTTPS request boundaries. Latest measured `pnpm test <file> --maxWorkers=1` wall times: upload **23.91 s** (20.72 s Vitest, including 14.87 s native compiler preparation), adapter **2.10 s**. The new bypass regression failed before the fix in **10.69 s** (1 failed, 9 passed); its passing test body took **8 ms**.
- Frozen dependency installation passes and every installed patched file matches its recorded target blob hash. An isolated npm-style tarball retains the four patched files and supports importing, constructing, and destroying the exported class after extraction. This is package-boundary proof, not a full release artifact.
- **Full build passes** (485.99 s wall) and **fresh P0–P2 autoreview is scoped-clean**. **All 21 proportional checks pass**, including core/infra/plugin/script types, targeted lint, SDK boundaries, npm lock generation, source ratchets, and patch registration. **32 session tests and 8 patch-guard tests also pass** (24.83 s and 3.26 s wall). The affected infra type graph replaces the known unrelated broad core-test failure under campaign policy.
- No live WhatsApp account, credentials, Convex access, or protected Gateway was used.

CI attribution: previous head `0651a43b17` [failed check-dependencies](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36349311750/job/108705677696) on unused `scripts/pr-lib/merge-prior-ci.mjs`, introduced on main by `b2e0e5627cb4` and absent from this branch; 63 jobs passed before fail-fast cancellation. Earlier unrelated failures were the media callback type issue owned by #159836, scoped-list drift in `compact-small-13`, and an unchanged retired `taskId` row in `artifacts-session-resolution.test.ts` after #159179 (also recorded by P-05 #159840). These surfaces remain untouched. No rebase, further refresh commit, merge, merge queue, or automerge was used.

Final head: `f31af9c8ddca3e142d33e7b7355c192614e190e9`.

- [Exact-head ClawSweeper review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/159851#issuecomment-5859074237) completed September 28, 2026 at 00:02 UTC: **ready for maintainer review**, no actionable findings, no security concerns, no before-merge requests. Fresh local autoreview is also scoped-clean.
- [Final-head CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36360312981) completed with 114 successful jobs, 59 fail-fast cancellations, 17 skipped jobs, and failures in `checks-node-compact-small-27` and the resulting `openclaw/ci-gate`. The run conclusion is cancelled; CI is **not green**.
- [WhatsApp CI shard](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36360312981/job/108736712666) passed all 93 files / 1,107 tests in 57.02 s, including all 10 upload tests and 32 session tests. Reported test-body costs total 0.453 s for uploads and 0.259 s for session tests; the new invalid-route bypass regression took 0.019 s. The [adapter CI shard](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36360312981/job/108736712498) also passed all 6 adapter cases under its Bun lane (0.005 s total reported test-body time). These are test-body costs, not isolated suite wall times; native Node request-boundary proof passed locally.
- [The failing fixture](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36360312981/job/108736712738) expects `scripts/e2e/bun-global-install-smoke.sh` to contain `assert-release-versions`. Main commit `47d9700dcf8c` (#159439) moved that implementation into `scripts/e2e/lib/bun-global-install/ai-candidate.sh`; the unchanged assertion still reads only the original script. Pinned base and this head have identical test blob `acb05e4d14f190e92223c91c4612053381deb2a8` and script blob `d02ec10d4e784ab33e68b9ef4d6e90285a90d079`. CI merge ref `9cb65f1b` retains that test blob but uses main's script blob `266e83f92168676d3c07eade4bfd162d6cff3453`, which lacks the asserted literal. This source-string failure is unrelated to the Proxyline patch; no fixture edit, rerun, refresh, or rebase was made.
